decisions.reason: The source clarifies predefined package-price ranges rather than the separately defined and deferred instant quote calculator.
The source specifies package pricing ranges but does not change the display or selection of individually priced services.
Square-footage-based package prices remain compatible with one-time pricing and do not alter the absence of monthly or annual pricing.
The package pricing categories do not affect gallery category tabs or the optional other-photography area.
The source changes package pricing details only and does not alter gallery hover behavior.
The detailed pricing content changes, but the requirement for homepage navigation to that content remains valid unchanged.
Package pricing ranges do not affect the homepage hero image emphasis or overlay presentation.
The pricing modification is unrelated to interactive gallery scrolling.
The source does not change the requirement to show representative imagery for each service.
The package pricing details do not alter the site's image-focused presentation.
